summary: Cycle 2 numerical-calibration replan: correct dt-scaled exchange-kernel sensitivity and non-stationarity, then rerun B0 health and E0 calibration before any confirmatory E1-E3 execution.
question: 在总资源量、资源边际分布、可达面积、人口数和财富初值均匹配时，资源景观的空间自相关性是否会改变稳态人口聚集和财富结构？

scope.inference_boundary: Cycle 2 is limited to numerical calibration and dynamics health. No landscape-effect, channel-attribution, or historical-causation claim is supported until C1-NUM passes and E1-E3 are executed.

claims.text: 修正后的 dt 尺度一致的交换核，在非退化小扰动初值下保持财富守恒和非负性，且主要观测量对时间步收敛；在预注册稳态窗口内通过漂移与有效样本诊断。
claims.falsification: 关闭地形生产、消费和财富衰减后，总财富相对漂移超过 1e-8，任一个体财富低于 -1e-12，dt/2-vs-dt/4 任一主要观测量平均绝对差超过 0.02，或任一稳态窗口归一化漂移超过 0.1、有效样本低于 4。

claims.text: 在资源总量、像素值直方图和可达面积匹配后，聚集型资源景观相对空间打乱景观产生超过数值噪声界限的人口空间结构差异。
claims.falsification: 配对种子的资源—密度 Spearman rho、密度 Moran's I 和占据熵效应全部落入由 E0 预注册的等效区间，或效应方向在保留景观上反转。
claims.blocked_by: C1-NUM must pass and the cycle-2 parameter lock must be finalized before E1-E3 design and execution.

claims.text: 景观效应可通过移动通道×生产通道的 2×2 因子消融分解为可量化的主效应和交互效应。
claims.falsification: 因子对比的区间估计无法排除数值噪声，或结果仅能识别组合效应而无法归因于任一单通道。
claims.blocked_by: C1-NUM must pass and the cycle-2 parameter lock must be finalized.

claims.text: 核心效应在预注册的人口规模、网格分辨率和未用于参数选择的景观家族上保持方向一致。
claims.falsification: 主要效应仅在一个人口规模或分辨率上出现，或在保留景观上落入等效区间或发生方向反转。
claims.blocked_by: C1-NUM must pass and E1/E2 confirmatory effects must be estimable.

analysis_policy.confirmatory_unit: paired random seed across matched landscapes
analysis_policy.uncertainty: paired effect sizes with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals
analysis_policy.multiplicity: Holm correction within each confirmatory metric family
analysis_policy.equivalence_rule: SESOI is frozen from paired same-seed dt/2-versus-dt/4 discretization differences in E0-NUMERICS-C2 after its calibration gate passes; it is a simulation-resolution limit, not a substantive social-science effect size.
analysis_policy.missing_runs: No seed replacement after outcomes are observed; failed runs are reported and rerun only under the declared failure policy.
analysis_policy.steady_state_rule: Use preregistered drift and integrated-autocorrelation diagnostics; do not extend runs because an outcome is close to a desired threshold.
analysis_policy.cycle2_calibration_gate: B0-DYNAMICS-PILOT-C2 health checks plus E0-NUMERICS-C2 conservation, non-negativity, dt_convergence, equal-state absorption, and stationarity must all pass before E1-E3.

experiments.objective: Run the revised candidate under active terrain with proportional wealth decay on umi and verify fixed population, wealth non-negativity, finite metrics, wall-clock cost, and steady-window stationarity for three seeds. No shuffled control and no landscape-effect estimate is produced.
experiments.baseline: Only clustered-active landscapes at N=500 and 64x64 resolution with wealth_decay_rate=0.002; deliberately no shuffled control.
acceptance: All three seeds pass steady-window stationarity diagnostics.
Minimum wealth is non-negative within -1e-12 and population remains exactly 500.
All reported metrics are finite and runtime stays within the declared timeout.
experiments.failure_policy: A failed health gate keeps the cycle-2 parameter candidate non-final. Parameter changes may use only runtime, stability and health diagnostics, never a clustered-minus-shuffled effect.

experiments.objective: Re-calibrate conservation, non-negativity, equal-state absorption, dt-scaled exchange convergence, stationarity and a paired discretization-resolution SESOI on a longer finite-time horizon.
experiments.baseline: Flat no-terrain equal-no-exchange and equal-exchange conditions, plus perturbed wealth conditions at dt, dt/2 and dt/4 with continuous-time exchange rate held constant.
ablations: continuous-time exchange-rate scaling across dt factors
acceptance: Max absolute total-wealth relative drift is <= 1e-8 and minimum wealth >= -1e-12.
dt/2-vs-dt/4 mean absolute change is <= 0.02 for every main observable.
Equal-state exchange max wealth variance is <= 1e-20.
All runs pass steady-window stationarity diagnostics.
experiments.failure_policy: Any conservation, non-negativity, dt-convergence or stationarity failure blocks E1-E3. Do not tune parameters for a desired social outcome.

proposed_B0_C2_cap.basis: 3 sequential runs x approximately 5x cycle-1 runtime (N=500, total_time=500) with 8 OpenMP threads and a 7200-second job timeout

proposed_E0_C2_cap.basis: 25 runs (5 seeds x 5 conditions) x approximately 5x cycle-1 runtime (N=1000, total_time=500) with 8 OpenMP threads and a 14400-second job timeout

budget.notes: No numerical experiment may be submitted until implementation review, valid git commit binding, preflight, and explicit CPU-time approval are complete. Cycle 2 requests no GPU.

computational_strategy.approach: Direct full-model reruns on umi with corrected continuous-time exchange-rate scaling across E0 dt factors; longer finite-time horizon and steady window for both B0 and E0.
computational_strategy.evidence_role: confirmatory for numerical calibration and candidate parameter finalization
computational_strategy.evidence_boundary: Calibration and dynamics-health evidence only. B0/E0 cannot support C2-C4 landscape, channel, or robustness claims.
computational_strategy.reference_method: Direct full-model paired same-seed dt/2-versus-dt/4 runs at total_time=500.

revision.reason: Cycle 1 E0-NUMERICS failed dt_convergence (wealth_gini 0.26584885869833064 > 0.02) and stationarity; B0-DYNAMICS-PILOT failed stationarity for all three seeds. Strategy action=replan limits Cycle 2 to numerical calibration.
code_changes: research/src/experiments/run_landscape_study.py: E0 perturbed dt conditions now scale exchange_rate by the same dt factor so continuous-time wealth mixing is resolution-invariant.
revision.legacy_evidence_policy: Imported results are exploratory provenance and bug history only; Cycle 1 negative results are preserved and are not pooled with Cycle 2 confirmatory evidence.
